wa_colfax_peak_polish_route.notes: From above a bergschrund that often requires a tenuous mixed traverse in from the right, a long sustained pitch of WI4+ ice leads to a snow slope below the crux band.

The signature pitch: 30 ft of steep ice easing before a transfer onto a free-hanging ice dagger - back-step off the main wall, hang off both tools, and move onto the dagger's vertical-to-overhanging face, which eases after a couple of body lengths.
Above the dagger, a couple more steep ice steps in the right-hand gully lead toward the upper snowfield.
The upper snowfield, with occasional patches of blue ice, cuts between rock buttresses and trends up and right to the summit; watch for afternoon sun softening this northwest-facing finish.

wa_east_face_2.notes: Traverse right toward the large hanging 'split block'. Establish climbing on solid granite with good natural pro from flakes and cracks. From the block, either climb the 5.8 finger crack straight up or keep traversing right on easier ground to the ledge above it. Build anchor for belay.
Critical 25-30 foot unprotectable section on dyke with minimal gear placements. Requires confident movement on moderate terrain with limited protection.
Climb chimney feature and progress up dirty corner. Moderate climbing with adequate natural protection from granite features. Build anchor.

Fun, laid-back climbing in obvious corner approach to summit. Final moves to the horned summit block are unprotectable and require careful route-finding. The last 15 feet take no protection. Downclimb to horn anchor with slings established for rappel.

wa_himmelhorn_wild_hair_crack.notes: Twin crack systems; the right-hand crack (the FA line) is preferred; anchor established at top.
The signature 12-inch-wide vertical crack with some face holds; protection is sparse for the first ~20 ft then improves. 4-star pitch.
Easy scrambling toward the false summit; belay at a notch just below it. Avoid the gully to the left for a cleaner finish.
Exposed ridge scramble to the summit block with airy low-5th moves.
